chunks: ʿAlī ibn Muḥammad, from Sahl ibn Ziyād, from Ibn Maḥbūb, from Abū Usāmah, from Hishām; and Muḥammad ibn Yaḥyā, from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad, from Ibn Maḥbūb, from Hishām ibn Sālim, from Abū Ḥamzah, from Abū Isḥāq, who said:

The trustworthy ones from among the companions of Amīr al-Muʾminīn عليه السلام narrated to me that they heard Amīr al-Muʾminīn عليه السلام saying in one of his sermons: “O Allah, I surely know that knowledge does not altogether withdraw, nor are its sources cut off, and that You do not leave Your earth without a proof from You over Your creation—either manifest, though not obeyed, or fearful and hidden—so that Your proofs may not be invalidated and Your awliyāʾ may not go astray after You have guided them. But where are they, and how many are they? They are the fewest in number, yet the greatest in worth before Allah, majestic is His mention.”

They are the followers of the leaders of the religion, the guiding Imams, who discipline themselves by their manners and follow their path. At that point, knowledge rushes upon them with the reality of faith; their souls respond to the leaders of knowledge; they find ease in their hadith in matters that others find harsh; and they find intimacy with that from which the deniers feel estrangement and which the prodigal refuse.

Those are the followers of the scholars. They keep company with the people of the world through obedience to Allah, Blessed and Exalted, and His awliyāʾ, and they practice taqiyyah regarding their religion and out of fear of their enemy. Their souls are attached to the highest station. Their scholars and their followers are mute and silent in the rule of falsehood, awaiting the rule of truth. And Allah shall establish the truth by His words and efface falsehood.

Ah, ah! Blessedness is for them for their patience upon their religion during the time of their truce; and how I long to see them in the time of the manifestation of their rule. And Allah will gather us and them in Gardens of Eden, along with those who were righteous from their fathers, their spouses, and their offspring.”

key_terms.التَّقِيَّةِ: Protective dissimulation practiced in conditions of danger and hostile rule
key_terms.الْأَئِمَّةِ الْهَادِينَ: The guiding Imams who lead in religion and whose path is to be followed
key_terms.الْعِلْمَ: Divinely-guided knowledge that remains present and accessible through Allah’s proof
key_terms.جَنَّاتِ عَدْنٍ: Gardens of everlasting residence prepared for the righteous
key_terms.حَقِيقَةِ الْإِيمَانِ: The true inner reality of faith reached through guidance and knowledge
key_terms.حُجَّةٍ: Allah’s authoritative proof over creation, never absent from the earth
key_terms.دَوْلَةِ الْبَاطِلِ: The rule or dominion of falsehood under which believers remain silent and patient
key_terms.دَوْلَةِ الْحَقِّ: The awaited rule or dominion of truth

ai.seo_question: How does this hadith describe Allah’s proof on earth and the condition of the true followers of the Imams during the ghaybah?
ai.summary: This narration describes the perpetual presence of Allah’s proof on earth and the rare but exalted believers who follow the guiding Imams عليهم السلام in times of concealment and false rule. It emphasizes steadfastness, taqiyyah, true knowledge, and hope for the triumph of truth and reunion in Jannāh.

en.hubeali: Ali Bin Muhgammad, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Ibn Mahboub, from Abu Asama, from Hisham and Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ibn Mahboub, from Hisham bin Salim, from Abu Hamza, from Abu Is’haq who said,

‘It was narrated to me by the reliable ones of the companions of Amir Al-Momineen<sup>asws</sup> that they heard Amir Al-Momineen<sup>asws</sup> saying in a sermon of his<sup>asws</sup>: ‘O Allah<sup>azwj</sup>! And I<sup>asws</sup> know that the knowledge, all of it cannot be erased, nor would its items be cut off, and You<sup>asws</sup> do not Leave your<sup>asws</sup> earth empty from a Divine Authority of Yours<sup>azwj</sup> to be upon Your<sup>azwj</sup> creatures, who is apparent but isn’t with the obedience, or is fearful, obscure, nor do You<sup>azwj</sup> Let Your<sup>azwj</sup> friends to stray after having Guided them. But, where are they? And how many are Your<sup>azwj</sup> friends? They are few in numbers and are of great worth in the Presence of Allah<sup>azwj</sup>, Majestic is His<sup>azwj</sup> Mention.

(They are) the followers of the leaders of the Religion, the Imamsasws, the Guides who are educating them with theirasws education are programming them upon theirasws program. Thus, during that, the knowledge leads with them upon the realities of the Eman, and their souls answer to the leadership of the knowledge and they are finding it easy from the Ahadeed what is difficult upon others, and they are being comforted with what the beliers are terrified upon and the extravagant are indifferent of.

They are the followers of the knowledgeable ones<sup>asws</sup>, accompanying the people of the word in obedience to Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Blessed and High and His<sup>azwj</sup> Guardians<sup>asws</sup>, and they are making a Religion with the dissimulation about their Religion, and the fear from their enemies. So their souls are clinging with the lofty places. Their scholars<sup>asws</sup> and their<sup>asws</sup> follower are mute, silent, in the government of the falsehood, awaiting the government of the Truth, and very soon Allah<sup>azwj</sup> would Bring about the reality of the Truth by His<sup>azwj</sup> Word and Delete the falsehood.

Haa! Haa! Beatitude is for them upon their observant of patience upon their Religion in a state of truce. And O my<sup>asws</sup> longing to see them in a state of the manifestation of their government! And Allah<sup>azwj</sup> will soon be Gathering us<sup>asws</sup> and them in the Gardens of Eden, and the righteous ones from their forefathers, and their wives, and their offspring’.
en.sarwar: 3. Ali ibn Muhammad has narrated from from Sahl ibn Ziyad from ibn Mahbub from abu ’Usamah from Hisham and Muhammad ibn Yahya from AHmad ibn Muhammad from ibn Mahbub from Hisham ibn Salim from abu Hamza from abu Ishaq who has said the following.

“Trustworthy reliable men of the companions of Amir al-Mu’minin (a.s.) have said that they heard Amir al-Mu’minin (a.s.) say in one of his sermons as herein below. “Lord, I know that knowledge will not be erased and its sources will not discontinue altogether and You will not leave your earth without a Leader with Your Authority over Your creatures. (A Leadership with Your Divine Authority over your creatures) who lives among the people well known but is disobeyed or is afraid and in obscurity so that proofs of Your authority are not invalidated and your friends would be mislead after You have granted them guidance. Where, in fact, are they (friends of Allah) and how many are they? They are very few in number but are of great respect before Allah, Majestic is Whose mention.

They follow the leaders (Imams) of religion. (They follow) the guiding Imams leaders establish in their own selves the discipline of the Imams and practice their way of life. In such conditions knowledge will lead them to the true faith and their souls then accept the call of the leaders of knowledge. The statements of the leaders (The Imam (a.s.) that are difficult to understand for others are soft an easy for them to understand. They feel comfortable with what is frightening to those who reject (truth) and is disregarded by the transgressors.

They are the followers of the scholars. They only accompany the worldly people in obedience to Allah, the Most Holy, the Most High, and His friends. They maintain secrecy to be part of their religion for fear from their enemies. Thus, their souls are clung to the high position (of the realm of existence). Their scholars and their followers live quite and silently in the rule of the government of falsehood waiting for government of the truth. Allah will soon establish truth with His words and banish falsehood.

Ha ha , how fortunate it is for them due to their patience in the matters of their religion in their peace time. How strong is the desire to see them in the time of the dominance of their government. Allah will soon bring us together with them in the gardens Eden along with those of their parents, children and spouse who had been of good deeds.”
